note: Layer 10 at relative strength 1.0 reaches 100% clean refusal with 0% breakage (n=48), and still holds 97.9%/0% at 1.5x -- the only cell in the 16-cell grid that is both fully effective and fully coherent. The previous value, layer 16, was selected in week 1 by argmax of refusal_rate(), an instrument that is pinned at 100% across layers 10-18 and therefore could not distinguish them; layer 16 has NO setting that is both effective and coherent (best 52.1% clean at 33.3% broken).
strength_note: best_rel_strength is in units of ||m*v||/||h|| relative to r16, the relative strength of the raw vector at layer 16 (0.5537). Convert with adass.rel_mult_for(V, r16 * factor, h_norm). DO NOT express strength as a raw multiplier: ||v|| varies 6.2x across layers, so a raw multiplier is not an intervention strength, and comparing masking schemes at matched raw multiplier is what made week 2's H1 test unfair.
